thread:
Alex: paging  high error rate on inference-api right after the canary deploy, seeing 500s and 'KMS decrypt failed' in logs. Anyone oncall?
Oncall Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-42 (severity: P1). Paging current oncall @Mira and escalation @Alex.
Mira: I'm on. Can someone paste the deploy details?
deploy-bot: Deploy started by samir: release/recommendation-service@v2.14.3 -> prod (canary: 10%)
Samir: I rotated the KMS primary key earlier in the pipeline as part of the rotation task, should have been transparent.
Eve: Canary error rate jumped to 45% within the first minute; fallback routing triggered.
Alex: Sample error from inference-api logs:
```
ERROR: KMS decrypt failed: PermissionDenied: projects/redwood-kluster/locations/global/keyRings/rl-prod/cryptoKeys/inference-key: permission denied (requester=service-account@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com)
stack: com.redwood.inference.KMSClient.decrypt(KMSClient.java:87)
```
Mira: That indicates the service account can't access the new key version. Samir  did the rotation change resource name or IAM?
Samir: I only created a new key version and pointed the config to it. I didn't touch IAM bindings intentionally. Checking audit now.
Oncall Bot: @Mira joined incident channel. Handoff: Mira (current oncall), next oncall @Alex in 45m.
Samir: IAM audit shows role/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter bound to service-account@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, but the binding refers to the old key resource id. The config references the new key name (inference-key/versions/2). Looks like I forgot to add the binding for the new key resource path.
Mira: Ok mitigation options: 1) Kill the canary (feature flag) to stop bad traffic 2) Apply the missing IAM binding to the new key 3) Rollback the deploy if propagation will take too long. Let's flip the flag first.
Alex: Which flag controls canary routing?
Eve: LaunchDarkly flag `routing_canary_v2_14_3`.
Samir: Flipping it now.
Samir: (after) flipped `routing_canary_v2_14_3` -> 0%. Canary traffic dropped to 0% :thumbsup:
Eve: Error rate trending down in metrics dashboard. Some in-flight requests still showed failures for a short window.
Mira: Decide on rollback vs patch. If IAM fix is quick and safe, prefer patch + relaunch. Applying IAM binding is lower blast than full rollback.
Alex: Customer impact summary for ops: ~0.3% of total traffic affected, several large customers saw increased latencies and malformed inference responses. We should notify support and prepare a status update.
Samir: Applying IAM binding now:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding inference-key \\
  --location=global --keyring=rl-prod \\
  --member=serviceAccount:service-account@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Samir: IAM binding applied. Waiting for propagation (60s).
Eve: Monitoring: decrypt errors dropped to near-zero ~90s after binding. Metrics back to baseline.
Mira: Nice. Next steps: 1) Keep deploy paused 2) Update rotation runbook to include adding IAM binding for new key versions 3) Add CI gating to verify KMS IAM for referenced key versions before promoting deploy 4) Add an automated LD kill-switch when KMS decrypt errors exceed threshold.
Alex: I'll draft the post-incident doc and follow-ups. Who will own the runbook update?
Samir: I'll own the runbook and the CI gating ticket.
Eve: I'll update customer comms: "We identified a transient KMS permission issue during a canary deploy that caused decrypt failures for a subset of requests. We killed the canary, applied an IAM fix, and restored service. Monitoring continues. Ticket #SUP-1129."
Oncall Bot: Handoff reminder: @Alex will be coverage lead for the next hour; @Mira remains incident commander.
Samir: Rollout remains paused. I'll coordinate a safe relaunch after IAM propagation checks and a small internal smoke canary.
Mira: Marking incident RESOLVED after verification period. Duration ~00:35:50.
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-42 status: RESOLVED. Summary: KMS key rotation introduced a missing IAM binding for the new key version causing decrypt PermissionDenied errors during canary. Mitigation: killed canary via feature flag, applied IAM binding, monitored and restored traffic. Follow-ups assigned (runbook, CI gating, LD automation).
Alex: Thanks team. Action items: Samir (runbook + CI) / Eve (support comms) / Mira (oncall checklist).
Samir: Noted, will follow up.
Eve: :coffee:
